question: To which unmanifest form dwelling in the great Malaya is obeisance offered?
premises: The addressee has an unmanifest form.
The addressee dwells in the great Malaya.
inference: Reverence is offered to the unmanifest form dwelling in the great Malaya.
plain_english: Obeisance to the one of unmanifest form, dwelling in the great Malaya.
